outline:
本課程教授人工智慧技術的基礎理論與實務技巧，並對於人工智慧不同產業的應用，提供啟發性的基本認知與創意。課程內容包括人工智慧與與現代科技，以及人工智慧的製造業與服務業的應用個案。
This course aims to teach students the basic concepts and practical techniques of artificial intelligence and to introduce its applications in different industries that could be inspring and innovative. The course include artificial intelligence and modern technologies, case studies in AI applications on manufacturing and service industries.
